payload.reason: The evidence indicates that a new set of error categories was designed to improve granularity and practicality in error classification, which was not adequately addressed by previous tagsets.

claims.text: The new error categories allow for evaluation at different levels of granularity, which was not possible with the Nicholls (2003) or CoNLL-2014 tagsets.
The new framework aims to balance informativeness and practicality, addressing limitations in existing tagsets.
The flexibility of the new error scheme enables more detailed observations about system performance compared to previous frameworks.
